reason: A WebUI desktop pet and interface enhancement that provides animated agent-state feedback, customizable skins and positioning, and local timer and reminder widgets.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加可拖拽、可换肤的桌面宠物，并提供与智能体状态联动的动画、闹钟、番茄钟和提醒功能。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable, skinnable desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness WebUI with agent-state animations, alarms, pomodoro timers, and reminders.

capabilities: Renders an animated desktop pet and settings panel in the WebUI
Links pet animation states to agent activity
Stores plugin settings in browser localStorage
Provides alarms, pomodoro cycles, sedentary reminders, and notifications
Serves bundled skin assets through a host route
